description: This file defines logging categories and a logging host class for PDFsharp, a .NET PDF processing library. It manages different loggers for document processing, image processing, font management, and PDF reading, utilizing Microsoft's logging framework.

classes.name: PdfSharpLogCategory
classes.description: Defines string constants for various logging categories used within PDFsharp.

classes.name: PdfSharpLogHost
classes.description: Provides static access to different loggers for PDFsharp, including methods to check and reset the logging factory.

methods.name: Logger
methods.description: Returns the general PDFsharp logger from LogHost.

methods.name: DocumentProcessingLogger
methods.description: Provides the logger for document processing activities.

methods.name: ImageProcessingLogger
methods.description: Provides the logger for image processing activities.

methods.name: FontManagementLogger
methods.description: Provides the logger for font management activities.

methods.name: PdfReadingLogger
methods.description: Provides the logger for PDF reading activities.

methods.name: CheckFactoryHasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the logging factory has changed and resets loggers if necessary.

methods.name: ResetLogging
methods.description: Resets all loggers when the global logging factory is updated.
